Package com.example.wackah_mole

Class GameViewModel

java.lang.Object
androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
com.example.wackah_mole.GameViewModel
public class GameViewModel extends androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel

ViewModel of the Mole Game ran on off of the main thread, handles the background game calculations

Author:
John Brittain, Nellie Leaverton, Seth Klaassen
